summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of OnCall Foot marketplace app via preview URL. Tested client discovery/booking flows, provider portal (dashboard, bookings, services, credentials, profile, readiness, travel zones), admin verification management, and registration. Backend APIs working well (75% pass rate). Frontend flows mostly functional with minor UX issues around logout visibility and booking flow completion.
